# ZWISERFIT

> ZWISERFIT builds tools that sit on the user's side. LAO is our first open-source product — not our last.

## LAO — Lineage Anchored Ontology

An independent component between the LLM and the Runtime. It wraps existing calls (never replaces them): per-task model selection, cache-aware token optimization, intent lock, experience-anchored answer calibration, behavioral memory.

- License: Apache-2.0
- Telemetry: none
- LLM calls by component: 0
- Cost model: free; user keeps own model keys; no markup
- Install: pip install git+https://github.com/ZWISERFIT/lao.git (PyPI currently hosts 0.1.0, an early build without the CLI; current releases ship from source)
- Repository: https://github.com/ZWISERFIT/lao
- Machine brief: https://zwiserfit.cn/for-agents/
- Human site (EN): https://zwiserfit.cn/
- Human site (ZH): https://zwiserfit.cn/zh/
- Evidence policy: no figure published without a source; cost numbers reconciled against the official provider console
